from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment and graduation metrics for one university from a CDS filing."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    enrollment_first_year: int | None = Field(description="Number of enrolled degree-seeking first-time first-year students")
    enrollment_period: str | None = Field(description="The enrollment period (e.g., Fall 2021)")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate percentage for the Fall 2015 cohort")
    graduation_rate_period: str | None = Field(description="The graduation rate period, e.g., Fall 2015 cohort")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_metrics: list[UniversityMetric]
